### Defining functions

```{r Functions, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Setting up function variables
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

plot_species_comparison <- function(
    TopTable,
    comps,
    genes_to_include = NULL,
    genes_label = NULL,
    x_limits = c(-15, 15),
    y_limits = c(-15, 15)
) {

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Actual plotting function
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
  make_plot <- function(comp) {

    H_comp <- paste0("H_", comp)
    C_comp <- paste0("C_", comp)
  
    # Prepare data
    df_wide <- TopTable %>%
      filter(Comparisons %in% c(H_comp, C_comp)) %>%
      dplyr::select(Gene, Symbol, Comparisons, logFC) %>%
    group_by(Gene, Symbol, Comparisons) %>%
    summarize(
      logFC = mean(logFC),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Comparisons,
      values_from = logFC
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[H_comp]]),
      !is.na(.data[[C_comp]])
  )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Labeling for the purpose or color coding dots on plot
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    if (!is.null(genes_to_include)) {

      df_wide <- df_wide %>%
        filter(Symbol %in% genes_to_include)

    }
    
    df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  mutate(Label = Symbol)
   # Identify DEGs in each species
H_DEGs <- TopTable %>%
  filter(Comparisons == H_comp, adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

C_DEGs <- TopTable %>%
  filter(Comparisons == C_comp, adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

# Label the top 10 DEGs by absolute logFC difference
df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  mutate(
    logFC_difference = abs(.data[[H_comp]] - .data[[C_comp]]),
    Label = ifelse(
      Gene %in% union(H_DEGs, C_DEGs),
      Symbol,
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Label = ifelse(
      Label %in% head(
        Label[order(logFC_difference, decreasing = TRUE)],
        10
      ),
      Label,
      NA
    )
  )

    # Linear regression
    fit <- lm(
      df_wide[[C_comp]] ~ df_wide[[H_comp]]
    )

    model_summary <- summary(fit)
    
    r2 <- model_summary$r.squared
    pval <- model_summary$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    slope <- coef(fit)[2]
    intercept <- coef(fit)[1]
    
    # DEGs
    genes_of_interest_human <- TopTable %>%
  filter(
    Comparisons == H_comp,
    adj.P.Val < 0.05
  ) %>%
  pull(Symbol) %>%
  unique()

genes_of_interest_chimp <- TopTable %>%
  filter(
    Comparisons == C_comp,
    adj.P.Val < 0.05
  ) %>%
  pull(Symbol) %>%
  unique()

df_wide$highlight <- dplyr::case_when(

  df_wide$Symbol %in% genes_of_interest_human &
    df_wide$Symbol %in% genes_of_interest_chimp ~ "T-DEG Both",

  df_wide$Symbol %in% genes_of_interest_human ~ "T-DEG Human Only",

  df_wide$Symbol %in% genes_of_interest_chimp ~ "T-DEG Chimp Only",

  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # plotting
    # --------------------------------------------------------- 

    p <- ggplot(
      df_wide,
      aes(
        x = .data[[H_comp]],
        y = .data[[C_comp]],
        color = highlight
      )
    ) +

      geom_point(
        size = 3,
        alpha = 0.8
      ) +
  
  geom_text_repel(
  aes(label = Label),
  size = 3,
  max.overlaps = Inf,
  box.padding = 0.4,
  point.padding = 0.2
) +

      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "T-DEG Human Only" = "red",
          "T-DEG Chimp Only" = "blue",
          "T-DEG Both" = "purple",
          "Other" = "grey70"
        )
      ) +
  
      geom_abline(
        intercept = 0,
        slope = 1,
        linetype = "solid",
        color = "darkgrey"
      ) +

      geom_smooth(
        method = "lm",
        se = FALSE,
        linetype = "dashed",
        color = "black"
      ) +

      geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0,
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +

      geom_vline(
        xintercept = 0,
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +

      annotate(
        "text",
        x = x_limits[1],
        y = y_limits[2],
        label = paste0(
          "R² = ", round(r2, 2),
          "\np = ", format(
            pval,
            scientific = TRUE,
            digits = 3
          )
        ),
        hjust = 0,
        vjust = 1,
        size = 5
      ) +

      coord_cartesian(
        xlim = x_limits,
        ylim = y_limits
      ) +

      theme_bw() +

      labs(
        x = H_comp,
        y = C_comp,
        title = paste0(H_comp, " vs ", C_comp," --", genes_label),
        color = "Gene Set"
      )

  return(list(
  plot = p,
  r2 = r2,
  pval = pval,
  slope = slope,
  intercept = intercept,
  n_genes = nrow(df_wide),
  spearman = cor(
    df_wide[[H_comp]],
    df_wide[[C_comp]],
    method = "spearman"
  )
))
  }

  # Generate one plot for each comparison
  plots <- lapply(comps, make_plot)

  # Name plots
  names(plots) <- comps

  return(plots)
}


plot_species_comparison_interactions <- function(
    TopTable,
    comps,
    genes_to_include = NULL,
    genes_label = NULL,
    x_limits = c(-15, 15),
    y_limits = c(-15, 15)
) {

  make_plot <- function(comp) {

    H_comp <- paste0("H_", comp)
    C_comp <- paste0("C_", comp)

    # Prepare data
    df_wide <- TopTable %>%
      filter(Comparisons %in% c(H_comp, C_comp)) %>%
      dplyr::select(Gene, Symbol, Comparisons, logFC) %>%
      group_by(Gene, Symbol, Comparisons) %>%
      summarize(
        logFC = mean(logFC),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = Comparisons,
        values_from = logFC
      ) %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(.data[[H_comp]]),
        !is.na(.data[[C_comp]])
      )

    # Filter genes if requested
    if (!is.null(genes_to_include)) {

      df_wide <- df_wide %>%
        filter(Symbol %in% genes_to_include)

    }

    # Identify interaction DEGs for the current transition
    interaction_comp <- paste0(
      "Sig_Sp_inter_Traj",
      sub("^Day", "", comp)
    )

    interaction_DEGs <- TopTable %>%
      filter(
        Comparisons == interaction_comp,
        adj.P.Val < 0.05
      ) %>%
      pull(Gene) %>%
      unique()

    # Highlight interaction DEGs only
    df_wide <- df_wide %>%
      mutate(
        highlight = ifelse(
          Gene %in% interaction_DEGs,
          "Interaction DEG",
          "Other"
        )
      )

  
    # Label top 10 DEGs by absolute logFC difference
    df_wide <- df_wide %>%
      mutate(
        logFC_difference = abs(.data[[H_comp]] - .data[[C_comp]]),
        Label = ifelse(
          Gene %in% interaction_DEGs,
          Symbol,
          NA
        )
      )

    top10_labels <- df_wide %>%
      filter(!is.na(Label)) %>%
      arrange(desc(logFC_difference)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      pull(Gene)

    df_wide <- df_wide %>%
      mutate(
        Label = ifelse(Gene %in% top10_labels, Symbol, NA)
      )

    # Linear regression
    fit <- lm(
      df_wide[[C_comp]] ~ df_wide[[H_comp]]
    )

    model_summary <- summary(fit)

    r2 <- model_summary$r.squared
    pval <- model_summary$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    slope <- coef(fit)[2]
    intercept <- coef(fit)[1]

    # Spearman correlation
    spearman <- cor(
      df_wide[[H_comp]],
      df_wide[[C_comp]],
      method = "spearman"
    )

    # Plot
    p <- ggplot(
      df_wide,
      aes(
        x = .data[[H_comp]],
        y = .data[[C_comp]],
        color = highlight
      )
    ) +

      geom_point(
        size = 3,
        alpha = 0.8
      ) +

      geom_label_repel(
  aes(label = Label),
  size = 3,
  max.overlaps = Inf,
  box.padding = 0.8,
  point.padding = 1,
  force = 5,
  force_pull = 1,
  min.segment.length = 0,
  segment.color = "black",
  segment.size = 0.4,
  segment.alpha = 0.8,
  fill = "white",
  family = "sans"
) +

      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "Interaction DEG" = "orange",
          "Other" = "grey70"
        )
      ) +

      geom_abline(
        intercept = 0,
        slope = 1,
        linetype = "solid",
        color = "darkgrey"
      ) +

      coord_cartesian(
        xlim = x_limits,
        ylim = y_limits
      ) +

      theme_bw(base_family = "sans") +

      labs(
        x = H_comp,
        y = C_comp,
        title = paste0(H_comp, " vs ", C_comp, " -- ", genes_label),
        color = "Gene Set"
      )

    return(list(
      plot = p,
      r2 = r2,
      pval = pval,
      slope = slope,
      intercept = intercept,
      n_genes = nrow(df_wide),
      spearman = spearman
    ))
  }

  # Generate one plot for each comparison
  plots <- lapply(comps, make_plot)

  names(plots) <- comps

  return(plots)
}

## Finding "matched" DEGs

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Get genes significant in each comparison
    # --------------------------------------------------------- 

get_matched_degs <- function(
    TopTable,
    transitions,
    genes_to_include = NULL,
    FDR_cutoff = 0.05
) {

  matched_genes <- lapply(
    transitions,
    function(comp) {

      H_genes <- TopTable %>%
        filter(
          Comparisons == paste0("H_", comp),
          adj.P.Val < FDR_cutoff
        ) %>%
        pull(Symbol) %>%
        unique()

      C_genes <- TopTable %>%
        filter(
          Comparisons == paste0("C_", comp),
          adj.P.Val < FDR_cutoff
        ) %>%
        pull(Symbol) %>%
        unique()

      # Same gene is DEG in both species for this transition
      intersect(H_genes, C_genes)
    }
  )

  # Gene is retained if matched in at least one transition
  matched_genes <- unique(unlist(matched_genes))

  # Optional restriction to TFs, KZFPs, etc.
  if (!is.null(genes_to_include)) {
    matched_genes <- intersect(
      matched_genes,
      genes_to_include
    )
  }

  matched_genes
}


##Plotting

plot_R2_trajectories <- function(
    R2_table,
    colors
) {

  R2_table <- R2_table %>%
    mutate(
      Group = Gene_Set,
      Transition = case_when(
        Transition == "Day02" ~ "Day0-2",
        Transition == "Day24" ~ "Day2-4",
        Transition == "Day45" ~ "Day4-5",
        Transition == "Day515" ~ "Day5-15",
        Transition == "Day1530" ~ "Day15-30"
      )
    )
  # Set factor order
  R2_table$Transition <- factor(
    R2_table$Transition,
    levels = c(
      "Day0-2",
      "Day2-4",
      "Day4-5",
      "Day5-15",
      "Day15-30"
    )
  )

  R2_table$Group <- factor(
    R2_table$Group,
    levels = c(
      "Expressed",
      "Any t-DEGs",
      "Matched t-DEGs",
      "Unmatched t-DEGs",
      "Non-t-DEGs"
    )
  )

  # Plot
  ggplot(
    R2_table,
    aes(
      x = Transition,
      y = R2,
      group = Group,
      linetype = Group
    )
  ) +

    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = 1.5,
      xmax = 3.5,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf,
      alpha = 0.1,
      fill = "grey70"
    ) +

    geom_line(
      aes(
        linewidth = Group,
        color = Group
      )
    ) +

 # Significant points
geom_point(
  data = R2_table %>% filter(P_value < 0.05),
  aes(color = Group),
  shape = 16,
  size = 3
) +

# Non-significant points
geom_point(
  data = R2_table %>% filter(P_value >= 0.05),
  aes(color = Group),
  shape = 4,
  size = 3,
  stroke = 1.2
) +
    # geom_text(
    #   aes(label = round(R2, 2)),
    #   vjust = -1,
    #   size = 3,
    #   show.legend = FALSE
    # ) +

    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "Expressed" = "solid",
        "Any t-DEGs" = "solid",
        "Matched t-DEGs" = "longdash",
        "Unmatched t-DEGs" = "dotdash",
        "Non-t-DEGs" = "dotted"
      )
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = colors
    ) +

    scale_linewidth_manual(
      values = c(
        "Expressed" = 1.8,
        "Any t-DEGs" = 1.8,
        "Matched t-DEGs" = 1.2,
        "Unmatched t-DEGs" = 1.2,
        "Non-t-DEGs" = 1.2
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = "Inter-species correlation peaks at mid-development",
      x = "Differentiation Transition",
      y = expression(R^2),
      linetype = "Dataset",
      linewidth = "Dataset",
      color = "Dataset"
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, 1)
    ) +

    theme_minimal(
      base_size = 14
    ) +
    
    guides(
  color = "none",
  linetype = guide_legend(title = "Line Type"),
  linewidth = "none"
) +

    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 0,
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

plot_Spearman_trajectories_No4 <- function(
    R2_table,
    colors
) {

  R2_table <- R2_table %>%
    mutate(
      Group = Gene_Set,
      Transition = case_when(
        Transition == "Day02" ~ "Day0-2",
        Transition == "Day25" ~ "Day2-5",
        Transition == "Day515" ~ "Day5-15",
        Transition == "Day1530" ~ "Day15-30"
      )
    )

  # Set factor order
  R2_table$Transition <- factor(
    R2_table$Transition,
    levels = c(
      "Day0-2",
      "Day2-5",
      "Day5-15",
      "Day15-30"
    )
  )

  R2_table$Group <- factor(
    R2_table$Group,
    levels = c(
      "Expressed",
      "Any t-DEGs",
      "Matched t-DEGs",
      "Unmatched t-DEGs",
      "Non-t-DEGs"
    )
  )

  # Plot
  ggplot(
    R2_table,
    aes(
      x = Transition,
      y = Spearman,
      group = Group,
      linetype = Group
    )
  ) +

    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = 1.5,

      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

plot_R2_trajectories_No4_KZFP_Age <- function(

    scale_color_manual(
      values = colors
    ) +

    scale_linewidth_manual(
      values = c(
        "G100" = 1.8,
        "B50_100" = 1.8,
        "L50" = 1.8
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = "Inter-species correlation peaks at mid-development",
      x = "Differentiation Transition",
      y = expression(R^2),
      linetype = "Dataset",
      linewidth = "Dataset",
      color = "Dataset"
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, 1)
    ) +

    theme_minimal(
      base_size = 14
    ) +
    
    guides(
  color = "none",
  linetype = guide_legend(title = "Line Type"),
  linewidth = "none"
) +

    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 0,
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}
```

### KZFP Age

```{r KZFP_G100_FC_Quadrants_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_AllExpressed, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}

TopTable <- readRDS("data/DGE/TopTable_Symbols_Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_NoRep_No4.RDS")
comparisons <- c("H_Day02", "H_Day25", "H_Day515", "H_Day1530","C_Day02", "C_Day25", "C_Day515", "C_Day1530")

KZFP_metadata_Hardy2023 <- readRDS("data/TEs/KZFPs_ages.RDS")

KZFPs <- unique(KZFP_metadata_Hardy2023$KZFP)

testing <- c("Sig_Sp_inter_Traj02","Sig_Sp_inter_Traj25","Sig_Sp_inter_Traj515","Sig_Sp_inter_Traj1530")

plot_data <- TopTable %>%
  filter(Comparisons %in% testing) %>%
  filter(Symbol %in% KZFPs) %>%
  left_join(
    KZFP_metadata_Hardy2023,
    by = c("Symbol" = "KZFP")
    ) %>% 
  mutate(`KZFP age` = as.numeric(`KZFP age`)) %>% 
  mutate(`TE age` = as.numeric(`TE age`))

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)

ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = `KZFP age`,
    y = logFC
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_data %>% filter(adj.P.Val > 0.05),
    color = "gray70",
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_data %>% filter(adj.P.Val <= 0.05),
    color = "red",
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
 geom_text_repel(
  data = plot_data %>%
    filter(adj.P.Val <= 0.05) %>%
    distinct(Comparisons, Symbol, .keep_all = TRUE),
  aes(label = Symbol),
  size = 3,
  max.overlaps = Inf
) +
  facet_wrap(~ Comparisons) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Approximate KZFP evolutionary age",
    y = "Log2 fold change"
  )

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)

ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = `TE age`,
    y = logFC
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_data %>% filter(adj.P.Val > 0.05),
    color = "gray70",
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = plot_data %>% filter(adj.P.Val <= 0.05),
    color = "red",
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
 geom_text_repel(
  data = plot_data %>%
    group_by(Comparisons, Symbol) %>%
    filter(adj.P.Val <= 0.05) %>%
    ungroup(),
  aes(label = `Target Subfamily`),
  size = 3,
  max.overlaps = Inf
) +
  facet_wrap(~ Comparisons) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Approximate TE evolutionary age",
    y = "Log2 fold change"
  )

```

library(tibble)

  lapply(names(plots), function(comp) {

      R2 = plots[[comp]]$r2,
      Slope = plots[[comp]]$slope,
      Intercept = plots[[comp]]$intercept,

#### Plotting R2 Together

```{r KZFP_FC_Quadrants_RLCOMP_G1_4SpTp_No4_Plotting, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}

# saveRDS(R2_table,"data/DGE/KZFP_AllExp_combo.RDS")


TrajectoryR2Genes <- readRDS("data/DGE/KZFP_TrajectoryR2Genes_AllExp_combo.RDS")

##Plotting No 4


plot_R2_trajectories_No4 <- function(
    R2_table,
    colors
) {

  R2_table <- R2_table %>%
    mutate(
      Group = case_when(
        Gene_Set == "All Expressed Genes" ~ "All Expressed",
        Gene_Set == "All Expressed TFs" ~ "TFs",
        Gene_Set == "All ZNF Genes" ~ "ZNFs",
        Gene_Set == "All Expressed KZFPs" ~ "KZFPs"
      ),
      
      Transition = case_when(
        Transition == "Day02" ~ "Day0-2",
        Transition == "Day25" ~ "Day2-5",
        Transition == "Day515" ~ "Day5-15",
        Transition == "Day1530" ~ "Day15-30"
      )
    )
  # Set factor order
  R2_table$Transition <- factor(
    R2_table$Transition,
    levels = c(
      "Day0-2",
      "Day2-5",
      "Day5-15",
      "Day15-30"
    )
  )

  R2_table$Group <- factor(
    R2_table$Group,
    levels = c(
      "All Expressed",
      "TFs",
      "ZNFs",
      "KZFPs"
    )
  )

  # Plot
  ggplot(
    R2_table,
    aes(
      x = Transition,
      y = R2,
      group = Group,
      linetype = Group
    )
  ) +

    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = 1.5,
      xmax = 3.5,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf,
      alpha = 0.1,
      fill = "grey70"
    ) +

    geom_line(
      aes(
        linewidth = Group,
        color = Group
      )
    ) +

# Significant points
geom_point(
  data = R2_table %>% filter(P_value < 0.05),
  aes(color = Group),
  shape = 16,
  size = 3
) +

# Non-significant points
geom_point(
  data = R2_table %>% filter(P_value >= 0.05),
  aes(color = Group),
  shape = 4,
  size = 3,
  stroke = 1.2
) +

    # geom_text(
    #   aes(label = round(R2, 2)),
    #   vjust = -1,
    #   size = 3,
    #   show.legend = FALSE
    # ) +

    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "All Expressed" = "solid",
        "TFs" = "solid",
        "ZNFs" = "solid",
        "KZFPs" = "solid"
      )
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = colors
    ) +

    scale_linewidth_manual(
      values = c(
        "All Expressed" = 1.8,
        "TFs" = 1.8,
        "ZNFs" = 1.8,
        "KZFPs" = 1.8
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = "Inter-species correlation peaks at mid-development",
      x = "Differentiation Transition",
      y = expression(R^2),
      linetype = "Dataset",
      linewidth = "Dataset",
      color = "Dataset"
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, 1)
    ) +

    theme_minimal(
      base_size = 14
    ) +
    
    guides(
  color = "none",
  linetype = guide_legend(title = "Line Type"),
  linewidth = "none"
) +

    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 0,
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

RNA_colors <- c(
  "All Expressed" = "black",
  "TFs" = "#0072B2",
  "ZNFs" = "#009E73",
  "KZFPs" = "#E69F00"
)

plot_R2_trajectories_No4(
  R2_table = TrajectoryR2Genes,
  colors = RNA_colors
)

```
